name: Passionlip
source:
Passionlip is a High Servant of BB in Fate/Extra CCC. 

[spoiler]Passionlip was created by BB as a Heroic Spirit-Complex. Classified as a High-Servant who is composed of three goddesses, Parvati, Durga, and Brynhildr. Parvati is the goddess of beauty from India who is a blindingly trusting and devoted goddess who loved her husband, the God of Destruction Shiva. Durga is the goddess of war, considered to be a facet of Parvati. She possesses ten divine weapons, and Passionlip's gigantic nails are the incarnation of these ten blades.

Brynhild is the goddess of war from Northern Europe. She was queen who was not able to join hands with her beloved hero and invited ruin from her sadness. She is treated as Brunhilde in Wagner's musical, appearing as a Valkyrie, a battle maiden, who escorts the souls of the dead to the heavens. Her circumstances were also a tragedy in which she despaired from love and raised her hand against her loved one.[/spoiler]
